items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Of course, I heard Ma Rainey too, but I think Bessie Smith was about the first one that I heard.

ctx.x: Gramophone -- it was -- I'm pretty sure it was Bessie Smith, one of the first ones. Of course, I heard Ma Rainey too, but I think Bessie Smith was about the first one that I heard. But I heard a lot of music in person from the -- these old guitar players because they'd drink a lot, you know, and come in and sing the blues and play these guitars.
